page.title: Inkundla yokuzama
page.lead: Buza imodeli yezinqumo imibuzo enezinhlobo mayelana nanoma yimuphi umbhalo noma i-JSON, uthole izimpendulo ezilinganisiwe ngokudlula okukodwa — ngaphandle kombhalo okhiqiziwe.

state.label: Isimo
state.placeholder: Umlayezo, ithikithi, idokhumenti noma ingxoxo okufanele kunqunywe ngayo

help.json: Into ithunyelwa njenge-JSON, okhiye besohlelweni ababhalwe ngalo. Uhlu lufundwa njengengxoxo futhi lufinyezwa kusukela ekuqaleni, ukuze kusale okushiwo kamuva kakhulu.

questions.label: Imibuzo
questions.help: Into ye-JSON enokhiye abangama-ID emibuzo. Umbuzo ngamunye unohlobo, imiyalelo futhi — ku-choice naku-score — nemibandela.

add.label: Engeza umbuzo
add.invalidJson: Qala ulungise imibuzo: ukwengeza umbuzo kungathatha indawo yombhalo ongeyona into ye-JSON evumelekile.

score.title: Isikali sokuhlola
score.desc: Sinikeza amamaki ngokwamazinga ahleliwe. Siphendula ngezinga elilindelekile.

checkpoint.label: Checkpoint
checkpoint.help: “Okuzenzakalelayo” kukhetha i-checkpoint ngokolimi lwesimo. Uma ukhetha eyodwa, zonke izicelo ziya kuyo, noma ngabe lunjani ulimi.

issues.title: Izinkinga okufanele zilungiswe
issues.questionsNotObject: Imibuzo kufanele ibe yinto ye-JSON enokhiye abangama-ID emibuzo.
issues.tooManyTotal: Okukhethwa okungu-{{max}} ubuningi sekukonke kuyo yonke imibuzo.
issues.badType: “{{id}}”: i-type kufanele ibe yi-choice, score noma noul.
issues.choiceNeedsCriteria: “{{id}}”: umbuzo we-choice udinga imibandela — into yokukhethwa noma uhlu lwamalebula.
issues.labelNotScalar: “{{id}}”: ilebula ngayinye kufanele ibe umbhalo, inombolo noma i-true/false.
issues.duplicateLabel: “{{id}}”: ilebula {{label}} ivela kabili (i-1, i-1.0 ne-true zibalwa njengelebula efanayo).
issues.scoreNeedsLevels: “{{id}}”: umbuzo we-score udinga imibandela njengohlu lwamazinga, kusukela kwelingezansi.
issues.noulCriteria: “{{id}}”: imibandela ye-noul ingachaza i-true ne-false kuphela.
issues.noulLabels: “{{id}}”: i-labels idinga imibhalo ehlukene ye-true ne-false.
issues.badBudget: I-{{name}} kufanele ibe inombolo ephelele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-{{max}}.

examples.intro: Khetha isibonelo ukuze usilayishe kubahleli. Akukho okuthunyelwayo uze uchofoze u-Qalisa.

review.title: Wanelisekile noma cha?
review.blurb: Imibuzo ye-yebo/cha. Amalebula aqamba kabusha impendulo, imibandela isho ukuthi yini ebalwayo.

bugReport.title: Hlola umbiko wephutha
bugReport.blurb: Isikali samazinga ahleliwe. Impendulo yizinga elilindelekile, elingawela phakathi kwamabili.

helpdesk.title: Dlulisela isicelo kudeski losizo
helpdesk.blurb: Okukhethwa okuchaziwe. Kwabelana ngesabelomali esisodwa samathokheni, ngakho uhlu olude luyacindezelana.

triage.title: Ukuhlunga amathikithi osizo
triage.blurb: Ithimba, ukuphuthuma nokubuyiselwa kwemali — imibuzo emithathu ngomlayezo owodwa esicelweni esisodwa.

resume.title: Ukuhlola ama-CV
resume.blurb: Izinga lokuhlangenwe nakho, ikhono elidingekayo nobuholi, kufundwe ku-CV.

guardrails.title: Izivikelo ze-LLM
guardrails.blurb: Bona umzamo we-jailbreak futhi uhlole umonakalo ngaphambi kokuba imodeli iphendule.

phishing.title: I-imeyili yokukhwabanisa
phishing.blurb: Isimo se-JSON: yonke i-imeyili, nomthumeli nesihloko.

german.title: IsiJalimane
german.blurb: Umbhalo wesiLatini, kodwa hhayi isiNgisi: kudluliselwa ngolimi, hhayi ngombhalo.

share.tooLong: Lesi sicelo side kakhulu ukuthi sabelwane ngaso njengesixhumanisi. Esikhundleni salokho kopisha i-JSON yesicelo.
share.inAddressBar: Akukwazanga ukukopisha ngokuzenzakalelayo: isixhumanisi sisebha yekheli.

code.fixFirst: Lungisa izinkinga zesicelo ukuze usibone njengekhodi.
code.jev: Noma iyiphi iklayenti ye-TypeSafe Jev isebenza ngaphandle koshintsho: yikhombe lapha nje. Igama lemodeli le sevisi engalazi libuyela ku-helexa/one.
code.key: Izicelo ezingenakhiye zisebenza ngaphakathi komkhawulo womphakathi. Ukuze uthole okwengeziwe, dala ukhiye we-API bese usetha i-HELEXA_API_KEY.

results.empty: Qalisa isicelo ukuze ubone izimpendulo lapha.
results.confidenceHelp: Ukuqiniseka kwempendulo kungamathuba empendulo ekhethiwe — inombolo elinganisiwe okubekwa kuyo umkhawulo. Ukuqiniseka kukala ukuthi konke ukusabalala kucace kangakanani (1 − i-entropy ejwayelekile; ku-yebo/cha, amathuba amakhulu) futhi akuqhathaniswa phakathi kwezinhlobo zemibuzo.
results.collapsed: Okunye okukhethwa kufinyezwe kwaba amathokheni afanayo ukuze kungene esabelomalini, ngakho imodeli ayikwazanga ukukuhlukanisa. Finyeza imibhalo yokukhethwa noma usebenzise okumbalwa.

routing.title: Ukudlulisela
routing.pinned: Isicelo sibalule le checkpoint, ngakho ukuthola ulimi kweqiwe.

usage.title: Ukusetshenziswa nesikhathi
usage.help: Izinqumo zikhokhiswa ngamathokheni okufaka. Umbuzo ngamunye ufakwa ikhodi kanye nesimo, ngakho umbuzo ngamunye owengeziwe mayelana nesimo eside ubiza leso simo futhi.

errors.rateLimitNote: Iphoyinti lomphakathi lamukela izicelo eziyi-10 ngomzuzu ekhelini ngalinye. Phinda uzame emva komzuzu.

validation.title: Iseva yenqabe isicelo
validation.help: Lungisa inkinga engezansi bese uqalisa futhi.

rate_limited.title: Izicelo eziningi kakhulu
rate_limited.help: Isevisi ikhawulela ukuthi leli kheli lingabuza kangaki.

server.title: Isevisi yehlulekile
server.help: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle kuseva. Phinda uzame maduze.

network.title: Isevisi ayifinyeleleki
network.help: Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese uphinda uzame.

timeout.title: Isikhathi sesicelo siphelile
timeout.help: Impendulo ayifikanga ngesikhathi. Phinda uzame maduze.
